name: TBL1X/Y related 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TBL1XR1 encodes f-box-like/WD repeat-containing protein TBL1XR1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); Pierpont syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Malignant Lymphoma; Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
